subject: Probability distributions: random variables and the common distributions
outOfScope: Probability axioms, set theory and rules of probability in depth; conditional probability and Bayes' theorem are taught in the Bayesian inference pack
Counting and combinatorics beyond the number of ways the binomial needs
Sampling distributions and the central limit theorem (a later pack)
Confidence intervals and hypothesis tests (later packs)
Joint, conditional and multivariate distributions, covariance between random variables
Moment generating functions, derivations and proofs
Describing data with means, standard deviations, z-scores and the empirical rule (see the Descriptive statistics pack)
The beta distribution and other priors (see the Bayesian inference pack)
Tooling: Excel, R, Python, Minitab and statistical tables
